definition: Originated or developed the project before financial close; often becomes an equity owner and then carries a second row
Holds equity in the project company; the share is the fraction of equity held (0 to 1). Investment, not operation: the same company may or may not also run the plant
Engineering-procurement-construction or turnkey contractor; share is the fraction of the EPC contract carried within a consortium, 1 when sole
Supplied main equipment (boiler, steam turbine, gas turbine, generator, nuclear island); share is the fraction of capacity supplied or blank when not stated
Operates and maintains the plant over its operating life; the tracker's Operator(s) field states this directly
Provided project debt; share is the fraction of total project debt
Export credit agency insurance or guarantee cover; share is the fraction of total project debt covered
